AND "q0"."code" = ?)) ORDER BY "q0"."tenantId" ASC, "q0"."code" ASC LIMIT ?) THEN 1 ELSE json_extract('x', '$') END AS "__viborm_assert__"
INSERT INTO "g2_identity_shelf_books" ("holder_1", "holder_2", "entry_1", "entry_2") VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT ("holder_1", "holder_2", "entry_1", "entry_2") DO NOTHING
SELECT "q0"."tenantId" AS "tenantId", "q0"."code" AS "code", "q0"."label" AS "label" FROM "g2_identity_shelves" AS "q0" WHERE ("q0"."tenantId" = ? AND "q0"."code" = ?)
